Everyone you ever ran with left a door cracked open somewhere You still know which ones to knock on.

DAILY / STANDARD

Personal

Prerequisite: You must be at least Expert in Streetwise.

Effect: Make a Streetwise check with a bonus equal to the higher of your Intelligence or +2 to reach out to an old contact in the area. Depending on the result, you find them if able, or you easily learn whether they’ve moved on from the area. A result b elow 10 means you can’t find or access them this time. When you use this power, determine whether you are asking for a favor or for knowledge; it must relate to their purview.

Favor: A favor may require persuasion depending on your past. Charisma checks and relevant skill checks to convince them gain a modifier based on the Social Mod of the check result (in addition to DM modifiers for the favor’s nature and size). You may raise their Influ ence / Access one row, but the Social Mod worsens by a further - 2 (you did not part on good terms). The DM may let this improve during play by doing favors for the NPC.

Knowledge: Roll a knowledge check using your own stats to see if the contact can answer your question; if they can, gain a bonus to your next knowledge check while talking to them, as long as it is information they would reasonably know (often set by the Influence / Access column). presentation.description:
A whistle here, a warble there — a private language hidden in the ordinary sounds of the wild.

DAILY / STANDARD

Personal

Requirement: You must currently be taking a short or extended rest in an area with local wildlife that makes sounds.

Prerequisite: You must be at least Trained in Nature.

Effect: You establish a set of signals that you and any allies resting with you understand. Choose up to 10 different signals and the message or phrase they are trying to communicate. They sound exactly like the local wildlife. You can make such sounds without mak ing a check, and they can be heard up to 1000 feet away. After hearing it, an ally can make a Normal DC Nature check to determine your general distance away and direction. Your allies that were resting with you when you used this power must m ake a Nature check based on your level - Easy if the area has a lot of low level wildlife, or a Medium Nature check if it has barely any or only high level wildlife - in order to gain access to the same calls. You and your allies can use these calls to mak e these signals until the next time you use this power, although they are only useful while near the current environment. Per the DM's prerogative, dense, forested areas, noisy wind, or other similar areas that can shorten sound may shorten the distance it can be heard up to half. Optimal conditions, such as an open area with soft wind to carry sound, or an echoing space, may increase the distance the calls can be heard up to 1 mile. Bird Call Signal Examples Some example signals you and your allies might establish: “Danger”, “Help!”, “Come back quick!”, “Run away!”, “All clear”, “Enemy spotted, move in”, “Enemy spotted, hide.”
